problem: Existing sealer holds full uncompressed body and payload, with temporary header+body concatenation. The comparison helper also copies gzip/raw/payload buffers. A future0.3125ps 34ns table is about833MB, so multiple full copies exceed2GiB AS.
proposal: Stream exact compressed/raw/payload hashes, native header/columns, every finite value and exact rowcount trailer; write only binary payload to an anonymous SSD TemporaryFile, bounded by explicit payload limit and1GiB SSD floors. Yield read-only NumPy memmap to the exact inherited all455 safety, complete measurement, time-grid and original startup routines. Comparator receives the same matrix and columns, preserving original crossings and fixed numerical policy.
required_saved_controls: Bit-exact full payload equivalence on original5ps,2.5ps,1.25ps saved captures
Original complete safety and measurement equality
Malformed header, labels, trailer, truncated and nonfinite payload reject
Explicit scratch limit and entry/continuous/terminal floor failures
Anonymous backing closes after normal and exceptional context
scope: No current producer or acceptance change. Reader-only adoption requires independent source and actual-control peer before integrating into future separately frozen sealer and comparison helper. No0.3125ps native is launched by this work.
